meta.name: customer-journey-map
meta.description: Create a customer journey map across stages, touchpoints, actions, emotions, and metrics. Use when diagnosing a broken experience or aligning a team on the full customer flow.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绘制客户旅程地图，诊断体验断点并统一团队认知
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要可视化客户全流程并发现体验问题
copy.tagline_en: Map customer journeys to diagnose experience gaps and align your team
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to visualize the full customer flow and identify pain points

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你按阶段（认知、考虑、决策、服务、忠诚）创建客户旅程地图，记录客户行为、触点、情绪、KPI、业务目标和涉及团队，用于识别痛点并改进体验。
howto.when: 当你描述一个客户角色和场景（如“为B2B SaaS的免费试用用户绘制旅程图”）时触发，或直接说“创建客户旅程地图”时启动。

say.text: 为我们的B2B SaaS新用户从注册到首次价值实现绘制旅程图。
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写各阶段细节。

say.text: 创建一个客户旅程地图，角色是产品经理，场景是从发现到忠诚。
say.note: Claude 会按框架逐步询问信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you to create a customer journey map across stages (Awareness, Consideration, Decision, Service, Loyalty), documenting customer actions, touchpoints, emotions, KPIs, business goals, and teams involved, to identify pain points and improve experience.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a persona and scenario (e.g., 'Map the journey for a B2B SaaS free trial user'), or when you say 'Create a customer journey map'.

say_en.text: Map the journey for our B2B SaaS new users from signup to first value.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through each stage.

say_en.text: Create a customer journey map for a product manager from discovery to loyalty.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details step by step.
